## Description

Undoes the effect of the [Enable Death Spectate Target HUD](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/enable%2Bdeath%2Bspectate%2Btarget%2Bhud) action for or more players.

## Snippet

```
Disable Death Spectate Target HUD(Event Player);
```
